name: interview-ai
description: An AI-powered full-stack interview preparation platform that analyzes your resume against a job description and generates a personalized interview strategy—complete with questions, answers, skill-gap analysis, and a 7-day preparation plan. It also includes an AI-powered resume generation feature to help create optimized, job-specific resumes.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend && cd backend && npx puppeteer browsers install chrome
